property_summary: For any caller and timestamp where the fallback accepts the call (msg.value == 10 ether and block.timestamp > pastBlockTime), if the call happens on a block with number divisible by 15 then the correct contract forwards its entire balance leaving address(c).balance == 0, while the mutant that transfers only 1 ether can leave a nonzero balance — so the rule is: after such a successful fallback on block % 15 == 0, address(c).balance == 0; the mutant violates this for some inputs.
change_summary: Transfer only a portion (1 ether) instead of the entire contract balance, altering post-call contract balance and observable behavior.
